note: Hand-written challenge-style tickets for milestone 2 sanity checks and to seed the milestone 5 dev set. Written from generic domain knowledge and the training resolution patterns; NOT derived from the challenge file. Labels are the author's judgement: service/work_type/resolution are firm, urgency/impact are soft, assignee is null where no pattern applies clearly.

records.Summary: Order rejects spiking for new broker
records.Description: Since 07:40 CET the matching adapter has rejected every block allocation booked with the newly onboarded executing broker for the Luxembourg SICAV range. The reject reason points to an unknown account on the broker side. Around 40 allocations are pending and the affirmation cut-off is 14:00.
All Comments: lea.moreau@intcom.com: Other brokers are affirming normally, only the new one fails.

records.Summary: Positions wrong in accounting this morning
records.Description: Front office sees yesterday's positions for all German mandates. The overnight position sync job ran for three hours and then failed with a timeout. The DBA noticed a session holding a lock on the staging table.

Email from our custodian in Frankfurt: their status feed is delayed by an internal incident and today's settlement status updates will arrive late. Meanwhile our side has already sent automatic fail-chasing messages to three counterparties for trades that have probably settled.

records.Summary: URGENT: email not working for new team
records.Description: Not an outage. The new Nordic client-servicing team starts on Monday and needs a shared mailbox and a distribution list covering its six members, with send-as rights on the shared mailbox for all of them.

records.Summary: Tolerance check failed - Nordic Equity I
records.Description: The NAV tolerance check failed for the Nordic Equity fund, share class I: the day-over-day NAV move is 3.4% against a 1.5% threshold while the benchmark moved 0.2%. NAV publication to the transfer agent is scheduled for 16:00.

Monitoring raised a 'file not received' alert for the 06:00 Rimes benchmark delivery. When checked at 06:20 the file had arrived at 06:07 and loaded successfully, and the index weights match the vendor portal. No further alerts since.

I need access to the client report templates for the Swiss entity ahead of quarter-end, like my colleague has. I am not sure which role I need and my manager is away, so I cannot give an approver yet.

Since this morning's MFA policy change, about 30 users in the Paris office cannot complete the authenticator push when signing in to any company application through SSO; they get 'request denied'. SMS codes work for some of them as a workaround.
All Comments: noah.berger@intcom.com: Users outside Paris are not affected.

records.Description: Our margin call payment to the clearing broker failed this morning. The automated margin sweep from the fund's cash account was released after the bank's cut-off and was not executed, so the account is short by EUR 2.1m against the call.

records.Summary: SimCorp job warning on dividend events
records.Description: After the overnight ingestion, several elective dividend events for Nordic holdings show no options in the election screen and the option codes are blank. The election deadline for the first event is tomorrow at noon.
